title: stroke-imaging-increment-mimic: analysis code and protocols for report-derived neuroimaging phenotypes and dynamic ICU risk after acute stroke
description: Analysis code, every version of the analysis protocol, and the extraction prompt and rules for the study 'Dynamic Risk Stratification for Short-Term Deterioration After Acute Stroke: Incremental Value of Radiology-Report-Derived Neuroimaging Phenotypes Beyond Dynamic ICU States' (MIMIC-IV v3.1, MIMIC-IV-Note v2.2). Contains no data: MIMIC-IV is available to credentialed users through PhysioNet.

creators.name: Lei, Ping
